name: smarthire-ai
description: Smart Hire AI — Electron desktop app and its Next.js licensing backend
_comment_workspaces: SPLIT 2026-09-01: packages/* are listed FIRST so npm links them before the apps that depend on them. smarthire-pricing has no dependencies and no peer dependencies at all — that is what keeps apps/desktop (React 18, Tailwind 3, pinned deliberately; see the version note in the README) able to consume it one day without npm resolving a second React into the tree.
_comment_dev: SPLIT 2026-09-01: `dev` keeps meaning "everything", which is now three processes. `dev:front` is the loop most work actually needs — site on 3002 and app on 3000, without Electron — because three Next/Vite/Electron processes under the 512MB cap is heavy. The ports are not interchangeable: apps/desktop/.env points WEB_URL at 127.0.0.1:3000, so if the site could take that port the desktop would silently talk to it.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n site,web,desktop -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:site" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.dev:front: concurrently -n site,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:site" "npm run dev:web"
